encoding: MCX1: gzip of 24-byte header (magic, uint32-le shape_xyz, run_count, palette_count), followed by uint32-le (palette_index, run_length) pairs. X varies fastest, then Y, then Z.
method: Lossless native 8/8/40 nm segmentation labels. Exact coplanar voxel faces are merged; no smoothing, downsampling, component removal or artificial crop caps. Surrounding labels are not classified as axons.
